quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: Your manager praises your work in front of the whole team.
quests.hint: Your hard work has been noticed by someone in authority.
quests.explanation: Being praised in front of colleagues makes you feel proud.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: You find out that a close friend lied to you about something important.
quests.hint: Trust is the most important part of a friendship.
quests.explanation: Discovering that a friend lied to you makes you feel betrayed.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: The waiter brings you the wrong dish at the restaurant.
quests.hint: The food on your plate is not what you wanted.
quests.explanation: Getting the wrong food at a restaurant is frustrating.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: Your phone rings with an unknown number at midnight.
quests.hint: Something unusual is happening very late at night.
quests.explanation: A midnight phone call from an unknown number makes you feel alarmed.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: The bus arrives exactly when you need it and you are already running late.
quests.hint: Something worked out perfectly just when you needed it.
quests.explanation: When transport arrives at exactly the right moment you feel relieved.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: Your boss cancels an important meeting without explanation five minutes before it starts.
quests.hint: You prepared carefully for this but the plan has changed.
quests.explanation: When a meeting you prepared for is cancelled without explanation you feel confused.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: You walk into a room full of people and they all go completely quiet.
quests.hint: Everyone's eyes are suddenly focused on you.
quests.explanation: When a room goes silent as you enter you become self-conscious.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: You try a new hobby for the first time and immediately love it.
quests.hint: You discovered something wonderful and new about yourself.
quests.explanation: When you try something new and enjoy it you feel enthusiastic.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: Someone has taken your reserved seat on the train.
quests.hint: You had a seat reserved but someone else is sitting there.
quests.explanation: When someone takes your seat you feel annoyed.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: You receive a message saying your flight is delayed by three hours.
quests.hint: Your travel plans have been disrupted and you will arrive late.
quests.explanation: A flight delay means waiting longer and arriving late which causes frustration.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: A stranger smiles at you warmly as you pass on the street.
quests.hint: Someone shared a simple friendly unexpected moment.
quests.explanation: An unexpected smile from a stranger makes you feel warmhearted.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: You cannot remember something very important that someone told you yesterday.
quests.hint: You know the information is somewhere in your memory but you cannot reach it.
quests.explanation: Forgetting something important makes you feel frustrated.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: You finally finish reading a very long and boring work report.
quests.hint: A long and tedious task is finally completely done.
quests.explanation: Finishing a long dull task makes you feel relieved.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: Your phone battery dies at the exact moment you need it most.
quests.hint: An essential tool has stopped working at a critical moment.
quests.explanation: Losing your phone battery at a critical moment makes you feel panicked.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: You tell a joke and the whole group laughs together.
quests.hint: Your sense of humor worked and people responded!
quests.explanation: Making others laugh with your joke makes you feel satisfied.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: Your city is featured positively on a national news programme.
quests.hint: Your hometown is being praised and recognized nationally.
quests.explanation: Seeing your city celebrated on the news fills you with civic pride.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: You have to give a short speech in front of one hundred people.
quests.hint: All eyes and ears will be focused on you.
quests.explanation: Public speaking in front of a large audience makes most people feel nervous.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: You find twenty pounds in the pocket of an old jacket.
quests.hint: An unexpected and pleasant surprise just happened!
quests.explanation: Finding money you had forgotten about makes you feel delighted.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: Your neighbour plays loud music at midnight every night.
quests.hint: Someone is disturbing your peace and preventing you from sleeping.
quests.explanation: Loud noise late at night when you need to sleep is very annoying.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: Your doctor tells you that all your test results are completely clear.
quests.hint: Your health worry is now completely gone.
quests.explanation: Hearing that your health is fine after worrying about test results makes you feel deeply relieved.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: You try to pay at the supermarket checkout and your card is declined.
quests.hint: This is happening in front of other shoppers in the queue.
quests.explanation: Having your card declined in public is a mortifying experience.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: You are asked to work overtime for the third evening this week.
quests.hint: You feel this situation is becoming unfair and one-sided.
quests.explanation: Being repeatedly asked to work extra hours can make you feel resentful.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: You accidentally send a personal message to your manager instead of your friend.
quests.hint: A private message was sent to completely the wrong person.
quests.explanation: Sending a personal message to your manager by mistake is horrifying.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: You receive a full refund for a faulty product you bought last week.
quests.hint: The problem was resolved fairly and to your benefit.
quests.explanation: When a complaint is resolved fairly you feel satisfied.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: A project you worked on for several months does not succeed.
quests.hint: Something you invested a great deal of time and effort in has failed.
quests.explanation: When a long important project fails you feel devastated.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: A colleague you greatly respect gives you a personal compliment.
quests.hint: Someone whose opinion matters deeply to you has praised you.
quests.explanation: Being praised by someone you respect makes you feel flattered.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: Your internet connection drops during an important video call at work.
quests.hint: Technology has failed at the worst possible moment.
quests.explanation: Losing your connection during an important call makes you feel flustered.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: You unexpectedly meet your favourite author at a bookshop event.
quests.hint: You admire this person's work enormously.
quests.explanation: Meeting someone you truly admire makes you feel starstruck.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: The restaurant brings you the wrong bill with someone else's food on it.
quests.hint: The information in front of you does not match what you ordered.
quests.explanation: Receiving an incorrect bill at a restaurant makes you feel confused.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: You wake up an hour before your alarm and cannot fall back to sleep.
quests.hint: You have lost extra sleep time for absolutely no reason.
quests.explanation: Waking up early when you do not need to and cannot sleep is annoying.
